title: Add CLI integration tests with testscript
description: Add CLI integration tests using testscript to verify observable behavior
acceptance_criteria: testscript suite in cmd/elbereth/main_test.go passes and covers key commands (run, build, init)

title: Fix path normalization for --path flag
description: Ensure that the --path flag correctly resolves relative paths to be relative to the Git root for tag and commit filtering.
acceptance_criteria: sv next --path ../other-module works correctly from a subdirectory

title: Machine-readable output (JSON)
description: Add a --json flag to all commands to facilitate automation and CI/CD pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: sv next --all --json produces valid JSON array of modules and their next versions

title: Refactor parser tests for behavior
description: Refactor parser_test.go to focus on observable behavior instead of AST implementation details
acceptance_criteria: parser tests focus on success/failure of parsing valid/invalid inputs rather than internal AST structure

title: Consolidate internal tests into integration
description: Consolidate internal logic tests (eval, lexer) into higher-level script-based tests
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests cover the same logic with less coupling to internal state

title: Implement major, minor, patch commands
description: Add explicit major, minor, and patch commands to the CLI to force version increments.
acceptance_criteria: sv major, sv minor, and sv patch produce correct next versions

title: Create Typst Diploma Template
description: Create a beautiful diploma template in Typst in the templates directory. Diplomas should take arguments: course, instructor, dates, and student.
acceptance_criteria: Template exists in templates/diploma.typ and compiles correctly with example-diploma.typ

title: Convert x/sv to standalone module
description: Initialize go.mod in x/sv and update imports to treat it as a separate module.
acceptance_criteria: go build ./cmd/sv works with the new module structure

title: Refactor codegen tests for execution
description: Refactor codegen_test.go to verify that generated Go code compiles and executes
acceptance_criteria: codegen tests use go build/run on generated fragments instead of string matching

title: Integration Testing with testscript
description: Implement end-to-end testing for the sv CLI using testscript to verify monorepo tagging scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Integration tests cover: root tag calculation, module tag calculation, and --all flag functionality.

title: Epic: Core Implementation of sv
description: Main epic for building the sv tool for monorepo semantic versioning.

title: Project Structure and CLI skeleton
description: Setup the basic Go project structure for sv and define the Cobra CLI skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: sv --version works, sv next exists, sv current exists

title: Module Discovery Logic
description: Implement logic to find Go modules within the repository and determine their subdirectory paths.
acceptance_criteria: Identifies path-based prefixes from go.mod locations

title: Git Tag Parsing with Path Support
description: Extend tag parsing to support path-prefixed versions like path/v1.0.0.
acceptance_criteria: Parses both global v* and path/v* tags correctly

title: Scoped Commit Filtering
description: Filter git log to only include commits that touched files within a specific module directory.
acceptance_criteria: git log output is filtered by path since the last module-specific tag

title: Version calculation (Conventional Commits)
description: Calculate the next semantic version based on filtered commit messages.
acceptance_criteria: Supports feat (minor), fix (patch), and breaking change (major)

title: Documentation and Examples
description: Finalize documentation and add usage examples for monorepos.
acceptance_criteria: Comprehensive README and documentation in docs directory
